parent: native-full-22 selected checkpoint per language; no retraining or checkpoint reselection
method: Alternative shared-language threshold: for each development stratum sort benign scores descending; take score at floor(0.01*N), add an absolute0.0001 guard, and use the maximum across strata. Reject if the guarded threshold exceeds1. This reserves heuristic false-review headroom; not a statistical guarantee.
selection: Use development only. Eligible variants meet original99% concern recall and5% false review per stratum. Rank eligible original and margin variants by highest minimum stratum recall, then lowest maximum false-review rate, then lowest summed false-review rate, then prefer original. If neither eligible, retain original and record failure. Persist selection before opening calibration predictions.
motivation: Earlier3% development false-review budget in threshold25 exceeded5% on calibration. Predeclare a more conservative1% budget for the new native bases before their calibration results exist.
runtime_requirement: Any selected new threshold needs installed inference replay and fresh actual-runtime evaluation; cached MPS scores alone cannot approve release.
